When operating high‑performance LC‑MS/MS systems, scientists expect confidence in every result. SCIEX software solutions are comprehensive offerings of mass spectrometry software designed to help laboratories achieve ultimate analytical performance across research and routine LC‑MS/MS workflows. Built around SCIEX OS software as the core platform, SCIEX software solutions deliver fast, accurate, and conclusive results by unifying instrument control, method development, data processing, and compliance within a single, integrated software environment.
Our comprehensive portfolio of modern laboratory software helps you make the most of your mass spectrometry system.

SCIEX OS software is the engine that drives SCIEX mass spectrometry. It delivers powerful, intuitive control across the SCIEX portfolio—from nominal mass systems (triple quadrupole) to accurate mass systems (TOF)—while providing the tools you need to monitor performance, protect data quality, and maximize instrument uptime.

SCIEX OS software provides a modern, integrated environment for confident data processing across quantitative and qualitative mass spectrometry workflows. Designed to simplify review, improve consistency, and support defensible results, it helps laboratories process data efficiently while staying ready for what’s next.

The software is just as important as the hardware. The most recent SCIEX OS software is particularly user-friendly, making it ideal for day-to-day operation and training. Rawi Ramautar Principal Investigator at the Leiden Academic Centre for Drug Research

SCIEX provides expert mass spectrometry software support and integrated compliance services to help you get the most from your instruments—faster and with confidence. By running the right software for your workflow and regulatory needs, you can improve productivity, ensure data integrity, and generate high‑quality results.

Our software ecosystem combines best‑in‑class capabilities with proactive technical and compliance support, delivered by experts who understand SCIEX systems and global regulatory requirements. The result is smoother lab operations, faster returns on your investment, and a lab that stays efficient and audit‑ready.
